page.notes: The small "»" marks at the right ends of several lines (in "co-»", "substa-»", "muliebre»") are printed quotation-continuation signs in the text column, not marginal notes, so they are kept inline. The line "est" stands below the last line, to the right, and is read as completing "principium est". The closing parenthesis is not printed, so the sentence ends without it. No catchword is printed.
